attribution.name: 王彦超
attribution.note: The Northern Song official who re-established the stele; he is the sponsor of the surviving recut, not its author.
attribution.noteZh: 北宋初重立此碑的官员，是现存重刻本的立石者，不是撰书人。

attribution.name: 安祚
attribution.note: The museum's transcription of the colophon reads 安祚刻字; the provincial summary gives 安仁祚. The two readings are not reconciled.
attribution.noteZh: 碑林页面录题记为「安祚刻字」，省志条目作「安仁祚」。两种写法并存，未作统一。

compositionDate.original: 唐贞观三年至四年（629—630）之间
compositionDate.note: The provincial summary places the first carving between 629 and 630; the museum page only says it was made before Yu Shinan's promotion in 634.

background: 唐贞观年间立于长安国子监孔庙，虞世南撰并书。原石刻成不久即毁，存世者为北宋王彦超重刻的「西庙堂本」，今藏西安碑林；碑身明代地震后断为三块。

review.note: Draft record from the museum page and a provincial heritage summary read on 2026-11-18. The two disagree on measurements, line length and the carver's name; the conflicts are recorded rather than resolved. The stone was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-18 阅读的碑林页面与省志条目整理。两处在尺寸、行字数和刻字者姓名上不一致；分歧照录，未作裁断。未核对原石。

notes: The museum gives 191 × 108 cm for the stele body; the provincial summary gives 280 × 110 cm. Neither is asserted in the structured field.
The museum records 34 lines of 64 characters; the provincial summary records 34 lines of 65 characters.
The carver appears as 安祚 in the museum transcription and 安仁祚 in the provincial summary.
The provincial summary associates a seal-script heading by 相王李旦 with a Wu Zhou recut; the museum describes the heading without naming a hand, so no title-writer is asserted.
The surviving object is a Northern Song recut, not the Tang original, which the sources describe as destroyed.
notesZh: 碑林页面记碑身高 191、宽 108 厘米；省志条目记高 280、宽 110 厘米。结构化字段不采用其中任一数字。
碑林记正文 34 行、每行 64 字；省志记 34 行、每行 65 字。
刻字者：碑林录作「安祚」，省志作「安仁祚」。
省志将「相王李旦书碑额」与武周重刻相联系；碑林只描述篆额，未记书者，故不主张篆额人。
现存实物是北宋重刻本，不是原石；所引来源均称原石已毁。
